g.text: MHA / MQA / GQA: what is shared?
[To be reviewed] Same four query heads in every panel; each KV tile represents its entire cached token history.
One KV head per query head
All queries share one KV head
Two queries share each KV head
Shared K/V does not imply identical attention weights: each Q head still computes its own softmax.
Payload ratios assume equal T, head width and dtype. Projection details, masks and batch axes are omitted.
